hero.intro_en: Write a short project plan for a small office move and send it to your manager. You practice writing clearly about scope, milestones, resources and deliverables, and you prepare your Capstone content: how you would manage a 2-week project.
hero.intro_es: Escribe un plan de proyecto breve para una pequeña mudanza de oficina y envíaselo a tu jefa. Practicas escribir con claridad sobre alcance, hitos, recursos y entregables, y preparas el contenido de tu Capstone: cómo manejarías un proyecto de 2 semanas.

hint.en: One sentence: what the project is and when it ends.
hint.es: Una oración: qué es el proyecto y cuándo termina.

rules.d_en: Dates, numbers and names, not “soon” or “some people”.
rules.d_es: Fechas, números y nombres, no “pronto” ni “algunas personas”.

rules.d_en: One idea per paragraph: goal, scope, timeline, resources, deliverables.
rules.d_es: Una idea por párrafo: objetivo, alcance, cronograma, recursos, entregables.

rules.d_en: Paragraph spacing, no bullet points or emojis.
rules.d_es: Párrafos separados, sin viñetas ni emojis.

example.subject: Project Plan – Office Move to the 3rd Floor
paragraphs: Here is my plan for moving our team to the 3rd floor by Friday, May 30.

The scope includes packing and moving 12 desks, setting up computers and phones, and updating the seating chart. It does not include buying new furniture or moving the printers, which Facilities will handle.

Milestone 1 (May 20): everyone has packed their personal items and labeled their boxes. Milestone 2 (May 27): the movers deliver all desks and boxes to the new space. Milestone 3 (May 29): IT confirms that every computer and phone works.
I will need two people from IT for one day, a budget of about $1,500 for the moving company, and our shared task board to track progress.
At the end, we will deliver a fully working new office, an updated seating chart, and a short report with lessons learned.
Please let me know if you'd like to change anything.

original.goal: Clear writing about scope and deliverables shows managers you can think like a project manager—even if it's not your title.
original.title: Outlining a Mini-Project Plan
original.body_en:
✍️ Writing Task

Title: Outlining a Mini-Project Plan
Time: 1–2 hours

Scenario:
You've been asked to coordinate a small office move.

Your Task: Write a short project plan (150–200 words) that includes:

The scope (what's included, what's not).

A timeline with at least 3 milestones.

The resources needed (people, budget, tools).

The deliverables expected at the end.

Why This Matters:
Clear writing about scope and deliverables shows managers you can think like a project manager—even if it's not your title.
original.body_es:
✍️ Tarea de Escritura

Título: Esbozando un Plan de Mini-Proyecto
Tiempo: 1–2 horas

Escenario:
Te han pedido coordinar una pequeña mudanza de oficina.

Tu Tarea: Escribe un breve plan de proyecto (150–200 palabras) que incluya:

El alcance (qué está incluido, qué no).

Un cronograma con al menos 3 hitos.

Los recursos necesarios (personas, presupuesto, herramientas).

Los entregables esperados al final.

Por Qué Esto Importa:
Escribir claramente sobre el alcance y los entregables muestra a los gerentes que puedes pensar como un gerente de proyecto, incluso si no es tu título.
